content.comment_body: I receive an error message after about a minute whenever I double-click specific coils labeled "M" or "IM." My setup includes Windows 7 Pro with the most recent version of [product_name] software ([version_no]), and I've increased Java memory to 2G; task manager shows javaw.exe uses only about 1G. This issue prevents me from naming coils, which is problematic since the program contains many unnamed contacts. Since I'm not the original author, remembering multiple coil functions is challenging. Does anyone know the reason for this error or how to resolve it?
Hi, Was this program converted from one diagram format (FBD) to another (LAD)? That often leads to similar problems. Could you share a few screenshot images showing the IM coil? Regards,

I work exclusively with LAD and haven't used FBD, nor do I have time to learn it. In this screenshot, both M5 and IM6 show the error—these are on the second and third rungs of the diagram. Sorry for the image quality.

I've been experiencing difficulty posting. To clarify, I only write in LAD and am unfamiliar with FBD. With these problematic blocks, sometimes attempting to connect causes the software to freeze longer than simply double-clicking. You can see in my screenshot where I tried to connect to IM5.
Hello, What you're attempting is recursion, which isn't allowed with IM or any other block. Please refer to your other discussion thread. Regards,

If this were a recursion issue, the software wouldn’t allow connection and would specifically indicate recursion. Instead, my program freezes completely—any further actions are disabled. In the screenshot, the line remains frozen, and I must wait around 5 minutes or terminate the program to unlock it. Repeated connection attempts lead to the same outcome. I can share the .lld file if anyone wants to take a look—I’d appreciate the assistance. Please let me know the best way to do this; I’m really stuck.

Hi, You can compress the program file and attach it to your post. Alternatively, you can send me a private message with your email address. Please include a note in the zip file describing the changes you need. Regards,
Did you receive my private message?

analysis.insight_summary: The user repeatedly encounters freezing and error messages in [product_name] when interacting with specific memory coils using LAD diagrams. This significantly delays or locks the program, making it impossible to rename coils, which is critical for understanding and maintaining inherited logic where many coils are unnamed. The issue obstructs usability and increases the cognitive burden for users tasked with managing and troubleshooting complex programs.
